# Exercises

All 56 exercises. The easiest way in is `.\gym`, which opens a menu. These commands work too:

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `.\gym next` | Open the next exercise in the interview plan |
| `.\gym open 07-02` | Open an exercise in your editor |
| `.\gym test 07-02` | Run its tests |
| `.\gym watch 07-02` | Run its tests again every time you save |
| `.\gym progress` | See what you have done |

**Fix**: code with failing tests to make pass. **Discussion**: a design problem to talk or sketch through. **Code review**: a pull request to review. **MAUI app**: a screen in the MAUI app to fix.
